messages:
Priya (CSM): FYI -- Lumenix hosted commit watch flagged a sharp spend deviation at 03:08 UTC. Alert: weekly projected burn now +230% vs commit, 95p latency +210ms, 5xx rate ~1.9%.
Ethan (DataOps): dashboard: https://internal.redwood/lumenix/health. Quick query run to surface culprit: 
```
SELECT api_key, endpoint, sum(tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls
FROM api_logs
WHERE customer='lumenix' AND ts >= now() - interval '12 hours'
GROUP BY api_key, endpoint
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 6;
```
Top result: key `nlx-ingest-01` -> 5.2M tokens, endpoint `/v1/embeddings` starting spike ~22:50 UTC.
Ravi (Support): Log samples show surge of 429s followed by 503s. Snippets: 
```
[22:52:03] id=zx12 path=/v1/embeddings status=429 reason=rate_limit_exceeded
[22:53:27] id=zx19 path=/v1/embeddings status=503 reason=kv_cache_pressure
```
Lina (Billing): Proj note: at this velocity they'll exhaust weekly commit by tomorrow AM. Recommend soft throttle + notify Sales for top-up conversation.
Anna (Lumenix): we shipped a nightly ingest pipeline update that streams an embedding per doc. We're pausing the job now; will audit batching and retries.
Taylor (Sales): tagged -- happy to discuss an interim commit bump if Lumenix needs runway. What's their current weekly commit?
Priya (CSM): Lumenix weekly commit = $2,400 equivalent (~9M tokens/week). At current rate they'd hit ~120% by tomorrow. Let's avoid surprise overages.
Ethan (DataOps): hypothesis: agent-side batching fell to 1 after a config change, causing tokens per call inflation. Also check for webhook retry loop from their queue.
Priya (CSM): Action list: 
- Ethan: provide per-key 15m time series and call-size distribution (ETA 20m)
- Ravi: collect 4 example request IDs and escalate to eng-runtime if 5xx persists (ETA 10m)
- Lina: stage a soft cap at 70% of weekly commit and prepare warning email copy (ETA 15m)
- Taylor: standby to offer commit top-up if customer requests (no outreach until we confirm)
- Anna (Lumenix): confirm when job paused and share SDK/config diff (ETA 30m)
Ethan (DataOps): quick snapshot: `nlx-ingest-01 -> 5.2M tokens / 62k calls; nlx-webhook -> 180k tokens`. Dominant key looks like batch job.
Ravi (Support): filing ENG-8023 with traces and payload samples; flagging for runtime oncall.
eng-runtime-bot: Anomaly ENG-8023 created. Assigned to @eng-runtime-oncall. Notifying eng-runtime channel.
eng-runtime-oncall: Acknowledged. Will investigate kv cache pressure and ephemeral memory. Will report in 25m.
Lina (Billing): Soft cap applied at 70% of weekly commit for `nlx-ingest-01`. Warn email queued (first warn then hold) — cap live. Projected burn with cap: +9% this week vs commit.
Anna (Lumenix): confirmed job paused. We're rolling back the ingestion change and will re-enable batching. Will send config diff in 20m.
Taylor (Sales): standing by. If Lumenix needs an immediate commit top-up we can offer a 2-week bridge.
Ethan (DataOps): mitigation note: recommend client-side batching enforcement, add jittered exponential backoff on retries, and re-enable prefix caching. If runtime errors persist consider serving a quantized model variant as fallback. I'll draft a short mitigation note for Priya to share.
Priya (CSM): I'll run a 14:30 local check-in with Anna and close the loop here. If metrics normalize after pause/cap we'll close. If not, we escalate for a post-incident review and renewal-impact assessment.
Lina (Billing): Cap confirmed live. Sending copy of warn email to Priya for review.
Priya (CSM): Thanks all. Keep updates in-thread. If anyone observes a renewed spike tag @Priya. Closing initial alert for now.
